pages.text: The Plasma Chain is the final fuel tier: ordinary fuel is progressively condensed into plasma fuel rods, used only by the Fusion Reactor.$(br2)$(bold)Upstream:$(reset) the activated crystals required come from the exhausted-fuel activator and centrifuge route, which is covered in Secrets of Life.$(br2)$(bold)Three steps, each with its own entry:$(reset)$(li)$(l:akaishi:plasma_fractionator)Activated Fractionator$(/l): splits activated crystals into components$(li)$(l:akaishi:plasma_aggregator)Fusion Fuel Aggregator$(/l): condenses components into plasma$(li)$(l:akaishi:plasma_filler)Plasma Filler$(/l): fills fusion rods with plasma$(br2)The finished rods are used in the $(l:akaishi:fusion)Fusion Reactor$(/l).

$(bold)A dedicated line:$(reset) plasma travels only through the Plasma Pipe and Plasma Fuel Tank; ordinary fluid pipes reject it. The line from the aggregator to the filler must be laid with these components.$(br2)All three rods contain 6 trillion energy each; they differ only in temper. Selection and combustion are described in $(l:akaishi:plasma_rods)Plasma Fuel Rods$(/l).
The three machines and the finished rods each have their own entry above; the $(l:akaishi:fusion)Fusion Reactor$(/l) is where they are burned.
